The first is a Hemingray No. 40, made of aqua blue-green glass, embossed with 'HEMINGRAY' and 'NO 40' on the base. The second is a Whitall Tatum insulator, made of clear-to-amber glass, embossed with 'WHITALL TATUM'. Both insulators show typical signs of age and wear, including minor surface marks and dirt. These used insulators are collectible pieces commonly sought by enthusiasts of antique electrical hardware.

PREMIUM BILOXI-AREA GULF COAST LOT
11,245 SQ. FT. • 71.2 FT. FRONTAGE • STARTING BID $13,500
16009 Towerbridge Avenue, Biloxi, MS 39532
Secure just over one-quarter acre in the established St. Martin community—conveniently positioned between Biloxi, D’Iberville, and Ocean Springs.
This wooded parcel offers approximately 11,245 square feet (0.258 acre) with 71.2 feet of paved-road frontage and a visible entrance from Towerbridge Avenue. Established residences, schools, shopping, dining, beaches, casinos, and interstate access are all nearby.
*Parcel Highlights
- Approximately 11,245 square feet / 0.258 acre
- Approximately 71.2 feet of road frontage
- Side boundaries of approximately 168 and 205 feet
- Rear boundary of approximately 60.3 feet
- Wooded and unimproved
- Existing entrance from Towerbridge Avenue
- Paved residential street with nearby homes
- Parcel #: 07155012.000
*Prime Gulf Coast Location
- St. Martin North Elementary: approximately 0.5 mile
- Walmart Neighborhood Market, groceries, and restaurants: within 1 mile
- Walmart Supercenter and The Promenade: approximately 3 miles
- St. Martin Middle and High Schools: approximately 5 miles
- The Home Depot: approximately 5–6 miles
- Biloxi beaches and casino corridor: approximately 6–8 miles
- Downtown Ocean Springs and Front Beach: approximately 6–8 miles
- Convenient access to I-10 and I-110
Enjoy quick access to D’Iberville’s major retail corridor, Biloxi’s beaches and entertainment, and the restaurants, boutiques, nightlife, and coastal charm of Ocean Springs.
*A Strategic Coastal Acquisition
The roads, homes, schools, shopping, and entertainment are already in place. Buyers may evaluate this property for an elevated coastal residence, custom-home concept, spec-build opportunity, or long-term Gulf Coast land investment.
FEMA mapping identifies the property as Flood Zone VE. All future uses, utilities, construction requirements, measurements, and property suitability must be independently verified.
*Auction Terms
- Starting Bid: $13,500
- Documentation Fee: $499
- Property sold AS-IS, WHERE-IS
- Applicable GovDeals fees, taxes, and recording costs are separate
- All bids are binding
BILOXI ADDRESS. ST. MARTIN SETTING. GULF COAST LIFESTYLE.
More than one-quarter acre—minutes from everything that makes the Mississippi Gulf Coast desirable. Bid to own the location.
